summary: A role's note at one level, a campaign, a project or the client, was written; the line records its size and hash, never what it says.

key.description: The role whose note this is.

old.description: The note this one replaced, by its size and hash, or null where the level held no note for the role.

bytes.description: The size of the note's canonical form in UTF-8.

new.description: The note as written, by its size and hash, and the level it was written at: a campaign's id, a project's id, or neither for the client.

campaign_id.description: The campaign whose note this is; absent at a project's or the client's level.

project_id.description: The project whose note this is; absent at a campaign's or the client's level.

role.description: The role whose note this is, the same as the key.

bytes.description: The size of the note's canonical form in UTF-8.
